OA-P2-2018-MJ::4.stem:
Guyana Press Associates is advertising to recruit a clerk for its human resource office. Anula
Boodraj has just completed a human resource training course which included communication,
technology skills, electronic document processing and management. The job requires the human
resource clerk to report to the human resource manager. Anula believes she meets the job
requirements and wishes to apply.

OA-P2-2018-MJ::1::q1-a.prompt:
List FOUR storage devices an office may use to store information electronically.
(4 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::1::q1-b.prompt:
Identify TWO functions of an organizational chart.
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::1::q1-c.prompt:
John has been working for five years with his supervisor, Miss Stephens, as her secretary.
John has told one of his colleagues that he does not like Miss Stephens and he is determined
to make her look ‘bad’.
(i) Identify TWO benefits to be gained by John from improving his relationship with
his supervisor.
(2 marks)
(ii) Outline a recommendation for achieving ONE of the benefits you explained in
(c) (i).
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::1::q1-d.prompt:
Shelly has been asked to prepare for a very important management meeting at which all
managers will need to have their own copies of the reports and be able to see the graphical
presentations as they are presented by department managers.
Explain how Shelly can use TWO named pieces of office equipment to meet the managers’
needs.
(5 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::2::q2-a.prompt:
List THREE ways to prepare for a successful interview.
(3 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::2::q2-b.prompt:
During a job interview for a receptionist’s position to work in a bookstore, you are asked
to explain the terms ‘physical deportment’ and ‘copyright infringement’. Write your
responses in the spaces provide.
(i) Physical deportment
(2 marks)
(ii) Copyright infringement
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::2::q2-c.prompt:
A vacancy requiring office administration skills is advertised. The applicant is required to
submit a curriculum vitae which includes the following specific details. You may include
additional headings and data as appropriate.
Specific details
Name: Shawna McLean
Address: 64 William Street, Kingston, Jamaica
School Attended: Bright Star High School (2012 – 2017)
Qualifications: 6 CSEC subjects at General Proficiency Level
Personal Objective
Holiday Jobs
Project Undertaken or Volunteerism
Reference
Draft a curriculum vitae for the applicant using the information above.
(8 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::3::q3-a.prompt:
A receptionist is the first person a customer interacts within an organization. State TWO
attributes/qualities receptionists must possess.
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::3::q3-b.prompt:
Amanda Sykers works as a receptionist in a multinational office in Bridgetown,
Barbados. A major function of her job is to follow-up on customers’ queries to ensure
that transactions are completed within three working days.
Describe ONE reminder system Amanda may use to ensure that all matters are followed
through to resolution.
(3 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::3::q3-c.prompt:
(i) Complete the reception register form using the information below.
On 29 April 2018 Mr Rajiv Goldson arrived for a 2:55 p.m. appointment with the
Marketing Manager, Miss Olivia Shields. Mr Goldson received an emergency
call to pick up his daughter from school and had to leave five minutes after he
arrived. He would like to reschedule his appointment. All timings must appear as
24-hour timings. (5 marks)

(ii) Write a note to Miss Shields stating why Mr Goldson was unable to keep his appointment. (2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::3::q3-d.prompt:
Mr Elvis Robins needs to travel on company business to Jamaica, Antigua, Guyana and
Barbados over the next two weeks. Payments for his hotel accommodation, meals and
local travel will be made by credit card.
State THREE advantages of Mr Robins’ use of a credit card for his business travel
expenses.
(3 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::4::q4-a.prompt:
Outline THREE duties Anula should expect to perform, if she is offered the job.
(3 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::4::q4-b.prompt:
As a human resource clerk, list TWO characteristics that Anula must possess.
(3 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::4::q4-c.prompt:
The Human Resource Manager explains to Anula that there is a performance appraisal
system in place. Explain, using six points, how a properly constructed appraisal may
serve as an effective tool in managing the performance of an employee.
(9 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::5::q5-a.prompt:
(i) As part of a work experience programme in high school, students are assigned to
work in the accounts office as an accounts clerk.
State TWO functions of the accounts office that may be observed by a student on
the work experience programme.
(2 marks)
(ii) Identify TWO duties an accounts clerk would expect to be assigned.
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::5::q5-b.prompt:
Briefly explain why confidentiality is one of the attributes required of a clerk in the
purchasing department.
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::5::q5-c.prompt:
As part of its cash controls, the Computer Repairs Services prepares monthly bank
reconciliation statements.
Using the information provided in the cash book and bank statement below, prepare the
revised cash book and bank reconciliation statement on page 17 for presentation to the
chief accountant on 30 May 2018.

OA-P2-2018-MJ::6::q6-a.prompt:
Patrick Green is a clerk in the sales, marketing and customer service department of Parks
and Hudson Company Limited. Maintaining accurate sales records is one of the functions
of the sales office.
(i) State TWO ways in which Mr. Green could maintain accurate sales records.
(2 marks)
(ii) State TWO functions of the marketing office apart from maintaining records.
(2 mark)
(iii) Identify TWO functions of the customer service department that are important in
maintaining good customer relations.
(2 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::6::q6-b.prompt:
Samantha Browne worked as a corporate communications clerk for the past three years
at Jambeck Corporation and has gained tremendous experience in this area. She is
planning to make a career change by securing a job at Intrinsic Company Limited.
Recommend to Intrinsic Company Limited, THREE ways in which Samantha could
improve the company’s image with prospective customers.
(6 marks)

OA-P2-2018-MJ::6::q6-c.prompt:
State THREE ways in which the destination sheet could increase the success of the operations, dispatch and transport services in the organization to more efficiently provide goods and services to its customers.
(3 marks)
